purpose: How an adjudication report becomes a campaign-DAG verdict. Each criterion is a mechanical rule over the group record, so the DAG node never parses solver artifacts and cannot quietly change what 'agreement' means. A criterion whose data is absent returns WITHHELD, which can never be promoted to pass.

criteria.description: a cross-solver comparison needs at least two non-excluded arms
no arm may be flagged conservation_fail
every arm carries input_digest + solver_version + git_commit
raw cross-solver spread on the total coefficient
every remaining difference must be attributed to term coverage / normalisation / discretisation / formulation; an unattributed spread is a fail, not a rounding note
